scientific_conclusions: MoS2 formula is not enough to infer 1T/2H/3R structure.
For bulk 2H, the review reports P 6_3/mmc and approximate a 3.15 Å, c 12.30 Å; individual primary determinations from COD must remain differentiated.
c-axis unit-cell repetition is not the same as the thickness of an isolated S–Mo–S sandwich.
RSC review, a journal excerpt, its COD record and a researcher's thesis may be manifestations of related evidence and must not be counted as independent experiments solely because URLs differ.
